notes.title: Mythwrecked v1.07 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, we’re still very solid with very few bug reports coming in, which is great! I've caught a few things internally so done a v1.07 patch (v1.05 and v1.06 were internal, hence the jump in version number) with the following fixes:-


 Edge case blocker bug where you can save after placing the final soulstone before triggering the endgame finale. On reload of that save, the endgame finale would not trigger.
 If you entered the South-Western beach at exactly 5am then the stars would remain in the sky for the rest of the day in that location.
 On very old PCs/Laptops we've had a report of the player character remaining tiny when emerging from fast travel. We can't replicate this, even on a 15 year-old laptop, but have made a change that we think will fix the issue. 
 Save benches, the mosaic and the chillout blanket did not have a highlight in the Atrium scene
 Fixed a couple of minor visual bugs


That's it! Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Mythwrecked V1.04 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Happy to report that we've had very few bugs reported so this is just a minor update. The fixes for V1.04 are as follows:-

-Fixed rare progression blocker where you can sprint from a non-Hermes friend favour to a gull and skip the dialogue quickly, meaning his points aren't allocated directly. 

-Fixed a typo in the game's final scene
